title: 7.5 Properties of Trapezoids and Kites

icans: I can find the angle measures of an isosceles trapezoid.
I can use the Trapezoid Midsegment Theorem to find lengths.
I can find the angle measures of a kite and name a quadrilateral as specifically as possible.

vocab: a ________________ with exactly one pair of parallel sides (the bases); the other sides are the legs
a pair of angles that __________ a base
the segment that joins the ____________ of the legs
a ________________ with two pairs of consecutive congruent sides, but opposite sides not congruent

blocks.p: Fold a sheet in half and cut a shape that unfolds into an isosceles trapezoid. Then fold another sheet and cut a kite. Measure.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Trapezoid: A trapezoid has exactly one pair of _______________ sides (the bases).
Isosceles trapezoid: In an isosceles trapezoid, each pair of base angles is _______________, and the diagonals are _______________.

blocks.stem: ABCD is an isosceles trapezoid with bases A̅B̅ and C̅D̅, and m∠A = 64°. Find m∠B, m∠C, and m∠D.

notes: Trapezoid Midsegment Theorem: the midsegment is _______________ to the bases, and its length is _______________ the sum of the bases.

blocks.stem:
a.  The bases of a trapezoid are 12 and 20. Find the length of the midsegment.
b.  The midsegment of a trapezoid is 15 and one base is 11. Find the other base.

notes: Kite: In a kite, the diagonals are _______________, and exactly one pair of opposite angles is _______________.

blocks.stem: In kite EFGH, the angles between the congruent sides measure 70° and 50°. Find the measure of each of the other two angles.
Show that A(−2, 0), B(0, 3), C(4, 3), and D(6, 0) form a trapezoid. Is it isosceles?
The midsegment of a trapezoid is 14. The bases are x + 4 and 3x. Find x and both bases.
In a kite, one of the congruent opposite angles measures 105° and one of the other angles measures 85°. Find the fourth angle.

tickets.stem: One base angle of an isosceles trapezoid measures 72°. Find the measures of the other three angles.
The bases of a trapezoid are 9 and 23. Find the midsegment.
In a kite, the angles between the congruent sides measure 80° and 60°. Find the other two angles.
